option_relations.rationale: Post-stroke seizure disorder is a different etiology for seizures than synthetic cannabinoid use.
Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (RCVS) is a distinct cerebrovascular disorder not directly related to synthetic cannabinoid-induced seizure disorder.

Synthetic Cannabinoid–Induced Toxic Encephalopathy is a broader condition that can encompass seizures, making it an etiological factor or a more general manifestation of the same underlying cause as 'Synthetic Cannabinoid-Induced Seizure Disorder'.

Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) is a distinct neurological condition, although it can be associated with various etiologies, it is not directly equivalent or a direct cause/effect of synthetic cannabinoid-induced seizure disorder.
